title: From Gift Nifty, Iran war, Nikkei, Kospi slump to oil price: 10 things that changed for Indian stock market over weekend | Stock Market News
summary: Indian stock indices Sensex and Nifty 50 are expected to decline due to the ongoing US-Iran conflict, which has escalated crude oil prices and inflation concerns, affecting global markets and triggering a sell-off in Asian and US markets.
sentiment_reason: The prolonged US-Iran conflict and its impact on global crude oil prices and inflation are causing strong negative sentiment in the market, reflected by significant losses in stock indices.
